claims.statement: Giovanni Battista Cybo, allied with Lorenzo de' Medici by marriage. Created Lorenzo's son Giovanni, the later Leo X, a cardinal in 1489.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Standard papal chronologies.
